newsitem.title: USA: Connecticut quarry dynamite blast kills man.
newsitem.headline: Connecticut quarry dynamite blast kills man.

text.p: A worker was killed and another critically injured when a stick of dynamite detonated unexpectedly at a quarry in Connecticut, authorities said Wednesday.
The men were working for Dyno New England Inc. of Middlefield, Conn., an independent contractor hired by the York Hill Trap quarry.
"This was a routine blast assignment by these individuals, who have been doing this for a long time. It's a very unfortunate accident," state police spokesman Sgt. Dale Hourigan told reporters.
The area was evacuated because 21 sticks of live dynamite were still on the scene. Federal authorities were expected to detonate them after an inspection.
Police said dead man was Joel Kanute, 43, of Wolcott, Connecticut, and Skip Sibley, 38, of Old Lyme, Connecticut, was critically injured.
